title: New user? Start now · the AI Foundry ET-SoC-1 lab
description: What a new user of the AI Foundry ET-SoC-1 lab does (ask Roman for an account and a Tailscale invite, log in once, give their coding agent the prompt), a diagram of the three machines and four cards, and the prompt itself: the rules and why, the first hour, setting up a Claude on the machine with Remote Control, the traps, and leaving the lab clean.
